IGUI_Canastra_Err_KeepOneCard: You can't run out of cards: you can't go out yet.
IGUI_Canastra_Err_KeepDiscard: Keep cards to discard: you can't go out yet.
IGUI_Canastra_Err_BlackThree: Black threes can only be melded when going out.
IGUI_Canastra_Err_DiscardTaken: You can't discard the card you just took from the pile.
IGUI_Canastra_Err_NoRedraw: Only the hand's first player may swap their first drawn card.
IGUI_Canastra_RulesReadOnly: Only the host can change the rules.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_pileTake: Open: take the whole pile freely. Closed: the top card must be melded immediately.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_pileVisible: Whether every card in the pile is visible or only the top one.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_meldSets: Allows melds of the same rank (e.g. 7-7-7).
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_naturalTwo: If on, a two of the run's suit in its own place (A-2-3) counts as a natural card. If off, a two is always wild.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_jokers: Adds the 4 jokers of both decks as wild cards.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_wildRule: Buraco: at most 1 wild per meld. Canasta: up to 3, with at least 2 naturals.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_handSize: How many cards each player is dealt.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_firstRedraw: The player who starts the hand may discard the first card drawn from the stock and draw another, once.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_drawCount: How many cards are drawn from the stock each turn.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_deadPiles: 2: one per team. 1: whoever empties their hand first takes it. 0: none. 1x1/2x2: a single one in 1x1, one per team in 2x2.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_deadSize: How many cards each dead pile has.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_goOutRequires: What the team needs on the table before going out.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_goOutNeedsDiscard: Whether going out requires discarding the last card.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_openCard: Starts the discard pile with a card from the stock.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_pileFreeze: Canasta: with a wild in the pile (or before the first meld) it needs a natural pair.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_pileLock: With a black three or a wild card on top, nobody can take the pile until another card covers it.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_redThrees: Red threes are laid down and replaced from the stock. Classic: 100 each (800 for all four), negative without melds, black threes only melded when going out. Per canasta: 100 each, negative if the team has no canasta, and black threes can never be melded.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_minInitialMeld: Minimum points for each team's first meld. Progressive: 50/90/120 depending on the score.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_bonusClean: Bonus for a canasta (7+ cards) without wilds.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_bonusDirty: Bonus for a canasta with wilds.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_bonusGoOut: Points for the team that goes out.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_penaltyNoDead: Points lost by a team that didn't take its dead pile.
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_blackThreePenalty: Points lost for each black three left in hand at the end of the round (instead of the card's normal value).
IGUI_Canastra_RuleTip_targetScore: The match ends when a team reaches this score.
IGUI_Canastra_Hint_SelectOneDiscard: Select a single card to discard.
IGUI_Canastra_Hint_PileNeedsMeld: Select hand cards that meld with the top card (or click one of your melds).
IGUI_Canastra_Hint_SelectCards: Select the cards you want to add.
IGUI_Canastra_Hint_DrawFirst: Draw from the stock or the pile first.
IGUI_Canastra_Hint_Staged: Meld set aside: %1 of %2 minimum points. Build another or confirm.
IGUI_Canastra_Hint_ConfirmLeave: Click again to leave the table (a bot takes your seat).
IGUI_Canastra_NewMeldTip: Meld the selected cards as a new meld
IGUI_Canastra_FourColorOff: Four-colour deck: off (green clubs, blue diamonds)
IGUI_Canastra_PileTakeTip_topMeld: Take the pile: click here, then on the hand cards that meld with the top card (or on one of your melds to add it there)
IGUI_Canastra_Status_Redraw: No good? Discard %1 to draw another (once).
IGUI_Canastra_Hint_PileJoinOrNew: Click a highlighted meld to join it, or the pile to meld separately.
IGUI_Canastra_Hint_PileArmed: %1 from the pile set aside: click the hand cards that meld with it, or one of your melds. Click the pile again to cancel.
IGUI_Canastra_Status_ReturnToTable: Sit back down at the table! The match is paused.
IGUI_Canastra_Status_WaitingReturn: Waiting for %1 to return to the table...
IGUI_Canastra_Status_DrawFree: Your turn: draw from the stock or take the pile.
IGUI_Canastra_Status_DrawClosed: Your turn: draw from the stock or meld the pile's top card.
IGUI_Canastra_Status_Play: Meld and discard a card (double-click discards).
IGUI_Canastra_SortSuitTip: Keep the hand sorted by suit
IGUI_Canastra_SortRankTip: Keep the hand sorted by rank
IGUI_Canastra_RedrawTip: Discard the drawn card (%1) and draw another (once)
IGUI_Canastra_StagedTip: Lay down every meld set aside
IGUI_Canastra_MatchWon: Victory! Your team won the match.
IGUI_Canastra_OurMelds: Our melds (click a meld to add the selected cards)
